notes.title: Patch note #9
notes.notes:
- Local co-op mode implemented where James is the new control character and you can explore with your friends. (you can also play online using Steam Remote Play Together!)
- Graphic improvements to some levels
- Adjusted collision detection of player's long-range attacks with walls
- Recovery items now fall more slowly
- Fixed an issue where jumping on mushrooms and landing on an aerial scaffold while receiving a reward for clearing a stage would cause the screen to go haywire.
- Fixed an issue where zombies would fall under scaffolding when summoned by the Goblin Banker style skill
- Fixed an issue where souls would fall down when destroying some enemies with aerial scaffolding
- Fixed a bug that caused Killer Rabbit to warp into walls
- Fixed a bug that caused damage notations on critical hits to Alice and Burn Girl in the crate to be white.
- Fixed stun and rollover behavior of flying enemies
- Fixed a bug that caused falling enemies to fall off screen if they were killed during a falling attack.

notes.title: Patch note #8
notes.notes:
- Added “Tornado is generated if the enemy is already in a laceration state.” to the effect of laceration
- Adjusted damage of Laceration and Tornado
- Increased Shadow Zombie damage
- Adjusted the amount of damage increased by skill enhancement
- Changed Medicine Ogre style's special attack bomb to explode immediately when it hits an enemy
- Adjusted enemy placement in some levels
- Reduced Mummy Papa's HP
- Adjusted the attack of the first boss
- Addition of BGM for the second half of the second boss
- Soul style type icons implemented
- Flame status icon added
- Operation tutorial added
- SteamDeck resolution support
- Fixed a bug in which the special attack detection was not triggered when parry was successful for Devil Coffin and Closet Tank styles.
- Fixed an animation bug when Medicine Ogre dies.
- Fixed the Hell's Taxi effect.

notes.title: Patch note #7
notes.notes:
- Adjustment of enemy placement in level
- Expanded the attack range of melee attacks
- Increased enemy fright time with melee attacks
- Added a small amount of HP recovery after destroying the mid-boss

- Reduced the Medicine Ogre's attack range
- Adjusted tracking of the player while the enemy is in attack stance
- Adjusted the tracking time of long-range attacks aimed at the player.
- Reduced damage range of Guest 1's explosion attack
- Reduced damage range of Guest 2's 3 consecutive attacks
- Increased gap between attacks of the second boss
- Adjustment so that enemies spawning at the final boss do not appear in overlapping positions

- Added a fright to the normal attack of Hell's Taxi style
- Fixed a visual glitch in the Hell's Taxi style
- Fixed an issue with Alice style special attacks where the counterattack is judged as a normal attack
- Fixed an issue with Scarecrow style skills blowing enemies off-screen

- Fixed an issue where the game speed would not return to normal when skipping the staff roll during acceleration
- Fixed an issue where the number of coins held in the store was sometimes displayed incorrectly

notes.title: Patch note #6
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in which enemies remained after the boss was destroyed
- Reduced the damage of some attacks on the third boss
- Reduced the damage of some attacks on the final boss

notes.title: Patch note #4
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in attack graphic of TV fish
- Fixed a bug in attack graphic of Egypetit
- Fixed a bug in attack graphic of Frog Fortune Teller
- Fixed a bug in which Mummy Papa's medicine throwing graphic was sometimes not displayed
- Fixed an issue where rewards were sometimes fixed to the ceiling
- Soul Resonance UI improvements
- Fixed bug where movement animations in Death and Skull Minion styles did not play correctly
- Fixed appearance of dash in Judgment Boy style
- Fixed appearance of Kinko's waiting motion
- Fixed spelling errors in character conversations
- Added enemies that can interrupt attacks with melee attacks

notes.title: Patch note #3
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where a standing picture may not be displayed or another character may be displayed when talking to a character in Home.
- Fixed an issue where a character's conversation partner was sometimes not displayed in Home.

notes.title: Patch note #2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in which items that could not be selected and no description was displayed when selecting an element bug.
- Fixed a bug in which the description of the special attack of the Hell's Chef Soul style was not displayed.
- Fixed an issue where the Lost Doll's conversation animation would not play.
- Fixed an issue where Alice in the Box style special attack counterattacks would not occur.
- Fixed an issue where damage from the lightning element bug did not occur when a Killer Rabbit style special attack hit.
- Fixed a bug where activating the Killer Rabbit style skill on the third boss would allow the player to move to an inaccessible location
- Fixed text placement bug in settings
